items.title: Show HN: Swormhörn a one-of-one cicada synthesizer [video]
items.contentSnippet:
Lately I've been playing with ESP32-S3 devices and HX710b Pressure Sensors in order to make unusual musical instruments.
SWOMHÖRN is a synthesizer that mimics the sound of individual cicadas and then allows the performer to control the energy of a swarm.
From a synth perspective, I treat a cicada as a percussion instrument, like a tube or block struck by a mallet. Swarms are simulated using the Kuramoto model which allows individual performances to fall into synchronous performance.

items.title: Show HN: Jev, Fly Me to the Moon
items.contentSnippet:
I built Odyssey, a browser based journey from  Earth to lunar orbit. 
It uses Jev from TypeSafe AI to choose between navigation actions. You can watch each decision and the probabilities assigned to the available options as the flight progresses.
The simulation provides the trajectory and maneuver timing. Jev chooses bounded attitude and correction actions within it. It’s a simplified cinematic simulation, with a deterministic fallback when the model is unavailable.
